title: Software Testing - Part 1
description: Software testing fundamentals covering test cases, bug reporting, functional/regression/integration testing, API testing, and automation with Postman, Jest, and Cypress. This submodule covers: Testing fundamentals, SDLC/STLC, Test cases, Test scenarios.
learning_outcomes: Understand software testing fundamentals and methodologies
Design effective test cases and test scenarios
Perform functional, regression, and integration testing
